acs.text_first_line: AC1 The treatment table is created in rwb_treatment with the fields of the module data model
AC2 The plan facts are held on the row and one running plan per case is enforced
AC3 The approved write is one transaction of row, decision record, outbox row and inbox row
AC4 TreatmentApproved carries the terms the clock needs and no personal data
AC5 The state follows the case and payment signals and never drives them
AC6 The migration is one version of this service's own sequence in one schema
AC7 The treatment read answers from rwb_treatment alone
AC8 The retired timer mechanism is absent from the schema and the code
AC9 No package version in force is a refusal and never a default

ops_provided: POST /api/recovery/treatment/v1/cases/{caseId}/treatments — writes the treatment row and its plan facts; right Treatment and offer C, Idempotency-Key required
GET /api/recovery/treatment/v1/treatments/{treatmentId} — reads the treatment with its terms, plan facts and outcome; right Treatment and offer R
ops_consumed: the parameters read of rwb-case for CURE_PERIOD_DAYS and plan.warn-days, one hop with a 2 s timeout (DP-06, DP-11); operation name Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2688; ASM-4433)

the reference-data read of rwb-case for LOV-TREATMENT, LOV-PROPOSER, LOV-APPROVAL-LEVEL, LOV-TRT-OUTCOME, LOV-TRT-SIGNATURE, LOV-CREDIT-RESULT and LOV-TIMER, one hop with a 2 s timeout (DP-07, DP-11); operation name Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2688; ASM-4433)
events_published: rwb.treatment.TreatmentApproved.v1 on rwb.treatment.events.v1 (EV-10), keyed by caseId, with treatmentId, caseId, treatmentType, approvalLevel, decisionLogId, firstDueDate, installments and offerAmount
rwb.decision-record.DecisionRecorded.v1 on rwb.decision-record.v1 (written through the RWB-PLT-E1027-CON library in the same transaction, DP-03)
events_consumed: rwb.case.CaseStateChanged.v1 on rwb.case.events.v1 (the route state that moves the treatment state)
rwb.payment.PaymentMissed.v1 on rwb.payment.events.v1 (the missed due date on the plan facts)
rwb.decision.RulePackageInForce.v1 on rwb.decision.events.v1 (the package version kept for the next write)
workflows: TreatmentWorkflow (child of CaseWorkflow, task queue rwb-treatment, namespace rwb-recovery)
